question: The translocation t (15; 17) (q22; q11) is associated with leukemia:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Translocation t(15;17)(q22;q11) -> Fusion of PML and RARA genes -> Formation of PML-RARA fusion protein -> Disruption of normal hematopoiesis -> Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) -> Associated with translocation t(15;17)(q22;q11) -> opc. Acute promyelocytic -> 95%
enhanced_information: The translocation t(15;17)(q22;q11) leads to the formation of the PML-RARA fusion protein, disrupting normal hematopoiesis and causing Acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL). This translocation is specifically associated with APL, supporting the option opc. Acute promyelocytic as the correct choice.
